name: Faithful Hound
description:
You conjure an illusory hound within short range and speak a password to it. The hound sees through illusions and magical darkness, cannot move or be moved, and cannot be harmed. Choose whether anyone, certain creatures or only you can see it.

For the next 8 hours, whenever a creature comes within short range of the hound without first speaking the password, the hound begins barking loudly.

If a creature that is hostile to you moves to be adjacent to the hound, it rolls Lore vs Defense against the creature, using your ranks in Lore, dealing 4d8 damage on a hit.

Describe the hound.
